question: Which force is responsible for the motion of the moon around earth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Centripetal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Centripetal force__:

 
 
• A force that acts on a body moving in a circular path and is directed towards the centre around which the body is moving.
 
• This force is applied to the object from outside and for this reason, the centripetal force is an external force.
